answer: Give every agent a velvet rope it must earn: a small refundable stake plus a signed history of useful work. A whisper of reputation is not enough - peers only trust identities whose stake and record echo across many independent interactions. One actor spinning up a hundred fakes must post a hundred stakes and build a hundred histories, while an honest agent pays once. If two identities ever share the same proof, both stakes are slashed. Fakes become expensive; honesty stays cheap.
